research.title: Visibility-Aware Consistency for Occluded Keypoint Localization
bullets: Formulated whether visibility estimates could prevent unreliable keypoints from dominating consistency training under partial occlusion.
Led development of visibility-weighted heatmap consistency, evaluating localization errors against unweighted training through synthetic occlusions and component ablations.

research.title: Illumination-Conditioned Feature Alignment for Low-Light Detection
bullets: Formulated how illumination-dependent feature shifts affect object detection when models trained on daylight images encounter low-light scenes.
Led development of brightness-conditioned feature alignment, comparing detection behavior against augmentation baselines and examining errors across illumination conditions.

research.title: Boundary-Constrained Pseudo-Labels for Weakly Supervised Segmentation
bullets: Formulated whether image boundaries could constrain pseudo-label expansion and reduce foreground leakage in segmentation learned from image-level labels.
Led development of edge-guided label propagation with confidence filtering, conducting ablations and examining segmentation errors around object boundaries.

publications.title: Edge-Guided Pseudo-Label Propagation for Image-Level Supervised Semantic Segmentation

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Local Feature Matching
bullets: Implemented patch descriptors and gradient-histogram descriptors within a shared pipeline for matching corresponding points between transformed image pairs.
Compared matching precision under rotation, blur, and viewpoint changes, inspecting incorrect correspondences and the effects of descriptor normalization.

projects.title: Transfer Learning Strategies for Fine-Grained Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature classification and partial fine-tuning using a pretrained convolutional backbone with consistent preprocessing and training splits.
Compared classification errors across visually similar categories, examining confusion patterns and sensitivity to augmentation choices and training schedule.

projects.title: Stereo Matching Under Texture and Occlusion Challenges
bullets: Implemented block matching and semi-global matching for rectified stereo pairs, including disparity selection and left-right consistency checks.
Compared disparity errors in textureless, boundary, and occluded regions, examining how matching costs and smoothness penalties affected reconstruction artifacts.
